Her career path shows enormous persevera: We must save money ahead of the summer holidays.
Marks a goal or an upcoming date. Some purists find it overused, but it is very common.

Su trayectoria profesional demuestra una: Cabe destacar la calidad del aceite de esta cooperativa.
Her career path shows enormous persevera: The quality of this cooperative's olive oil is worth noting.
Impersonal use of «caber» + infinitive meaning «it is fitting to». Formal register, typical of articles and reports.

Su trayectoria profesional demuestra una: Ahora bien, ese presupuesto no incluye los gastos de envío.
Her career path shows enormous persevera: That said, that quote does not include the shipping costs.
Introduces a qualification of what was just said. Not «now well».

Su trayectoria profesional demuestra una: Iremos de excursión, a no ser que llueva.
Her career path shows enormous persevera: We will go on a trip unless it rains.
Always takes the subjunctive. Synonym: «a menos que». No extra «no» after it, unlike Italian «a meno che non».

Su trayectoria profesional demuestra una: Por mucho que insistas, no pienso cambiar la receta.
Her career path shows enormous persevera: No matter how much you insist, I will not change the recipe.
A concessive that takes the subjunctive for present or future situations. «Por más que» is the same.

Su trayectoria profesional demuestra una: Sea como fuere, el museo abrirá sus puertas en marzo.
Her career path shows enormous persevera: Be that as it may, the museum will open in March.
A fixed phrase using the old future subjunctive «fuere». Formal and mostly written.

Su trayectoria profesional demuestra una: Debemos afrontar los problemas de salud con serenidad.
Her career path shows enormous persevera: We must face health problems calmly.
Used for difficulties and problems. To confront a person, use «enfrentarse a» instead.

Su trayectoria profesional demuestra una: No conviene desdeñar la experiencia de los empleados veteranos.
Her career path shows enormous persevera: It is unwise to dismiss the experience of veteran employees.
Cultured register. The noun is «desdén»; the negative «no desdeñar» is very frequent.

Su trayectoria profesional demuestra una: Esa decisión puede acarrear graves consecuencias económicas para la empresa.
Her career path shows enormous persevera: That decision may entail serious economic consequences for the company.
Almost always with negative results: problems, costs, consequences. Today it rarely means physically carrying.

Su trayectoria profesional demuestra una: El tren llegó tarde; no obstante, la reunión empezó puntual.
Her career path shows enormous persevera: The train arrived late; nevertheless, the meeting started on time.
A formal adversative connector, more written than spoken. Usually set off by a semicolon or commas.
